OpenmostCommunication.Matomo6Body: Openmost is an official Matomo Implementation Partner, working with Matomo since 2016. Upgrading now is simpler than catching up in a few months: new features and security improvements land on Matomo 6 first, and we move you there with your reports and tracking intact.
